name: José Antonio Primo de Rivera
role: Spanish politician and founder of Falange Española
contribution: A Spanish national syndicalist politician who founded the Falange Española, later Falange Española de las JONS.
photo_credit: Fondo Marín. Pascual Marín · CC BY-SA 3.0

checks.lead: José Antonio Primo de Rivera y Sáenz de Heredia, 1st Duke of Primo de Rivera, 3rd Marquis of Estella GE (24 April 1903 – 20 November 1936), often referred to simply as José Antonio, was a Spanish national syndicalist politician who founded the Falange Española ("Spanish Phalanx"), later Falange Española de las JONS.
